name: LUXU Clinic ลัคชูคลินิก สาขาแหลมฉบัง

summary_en: Located in Pattaya, LUXU Clinic Laem Chabang specializes in botox treatments. The clinic holds a 4.2-star rating based on 5 reviews and maintains a trust score of 62.1.
